notes: Go only. Selects the pi-typesafe Package: the typesafe_evaluate tool and the /typesafe command, off until the operator enables them. Run npm run stage before using its generated manifest under dist/staged.
Content submitted goes to api.typesafe.ai unless the own-model backend is selected, which sends it to the provider of the model PiG is configured with. The Piglet says which in its consent dialog.

A Piglet Binary builds locally from the staged manifest with PIG_SOURCE_ROOT set to a git checkout of the PiG source. Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release pig-typesafe/v0.1.1 (built natively by the release workflow; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-typesafe@0.1.1); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and no platform is a support claim.
